description.zh: 待删除的文件系统实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the file system to be deleted.

descriptions.zh:
- 仅当文件系统的挂载点数目为0时，支持删除文件系统实例。
- 文件系统实例一旦删除，数据将不可恢复，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
- You can delete a file system instance only when the number of its mount targets is 0.  
- Once a file system instance is deleted, its data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.
